_comment: UNI-235 model calibration. Cases are REAL UNI-233 decisions, not invented ones. expect=FLAG means the listed categories are wrong; expect=OK means they are right. The qualifying bar is on the PAIR, not on any one model: the union of all tested models must catch every FLAG case (recall matters more than precision here, because every flag reaches a human but a miss is invisible), and each individual model must clear >=9/12 so a weak model can't ride along on a stronger partner's coverage. It is pair-level by design, not a looser per-model bar — as measured, nemotron-3-nano:30b misses Ellucian CRM Recruit while mistral-small3.2:24b catches it; either model alone can miss a case the other catches, which is exactly what the union combiner is for. See scripts/category-llm-audit.js for the measured numbers.
